annotations.title: Buy a pack with store credit

description: Buy a shop pack with this account's store credit (see shop_packs' store_credit_cents), exactly like the shop's store-credit purchase (POST /v1/iap/store-credit). Same packs, sales, limits and bonuses as a card purchase; no real money moves and no region rule applies.

context.description: optional short note on why you are buying, kept with the purchase

sale_id.description: a limited-time sale id from shop_packs' sales, to buy at the sale price

sections.description: optional list of the Snapshot's top-level keys to return with the purchase, overriding snapshot; now is always included

snapshot.description: how much of the Snapshot to return after the purchase: none (default) no snapshot; changes only what the purchase changed (diamonds, items), in a changes field; city only now, config_hash, map_size, player, city, marches, rallies and notices; full the whole Snapshot

name: buy_pack_with_store_credit
title: Buy a pack with store credit
